conventionSource: Native six-section order and file_bitnet header syntax as reported on 2026-10-15 from read-only checks of the native process, summarized in CONTEXT_FORMAT.md. A reported convention, not verified compatibility. This mapping uses public field names only.

source.formatNote: the earlier public section order, with identity before the header

readerBoundary.nativeReaderInput: Only projectionText, or nativeHeader.text on its own. The file_bitnet block is the only native syntax either holds, and the JSON around them holds no author text either.
readerBoundary.reason: A reader that matches assertions or header lines without honouring quotation marks can take quoted author text for metadata. Every file in the list above holds author text. This projection holds only checked values, line numbers, sizes, hashes and the domain facets that pass the native list check.

sectionOrder: Header comment, with schema and provenance or filing metadata

sections.name: Header comment, with schema and provenance or filing metadata

assertions.mapping: filing: public release label (not an admission state)
doctrine reference: public label, link and location

headerMetadata.field: filing: public release label (not an admission state)

nativeHeader.note: At least one domain facet holds a character that the native list syntax cannot carry exactly. No block is written. The public definition keeps every facet as written; nothing was normalized, shortened or split.

review.note: Public review is personal and self-declared. It is not native institutional or model admission, and claims recorded elsewhere are not admission.

releaseLabel.meaning: A personal public context. Not released and not admitted.

unsupported.item: native header keys other than domain
unsupported.reason: Only authored domain facets are written, in the file_bitnet block. No other header key is emitted or inferred: no ownership, status or authority is taken from the self-declared author or from any other field.
BitNet flags are measurements kept outside definitions, and none has run. See the context sidecar.
The public form neither grants nor infers it.
Promotion or ratification claims recorded elsewhere are reported separately and are not admission.
Nothing is inferred from a release label, a review, a claim or quoted text.
Directory-level stubs, per-file contract wrappers and cascade cards are distinct formats. None is produced here, and the file_bitnet block proves nothing about them.
It stays in the source definition, pinned by hash, so quoted wording cannot be read as metadata here. Each field gives its source line, size and SHA-256 instead.

unsupported.item: native fields or rules beyond the declared public fields
unsupported.reason: Only public fields are mapped; nothing is invented to fill native fields.

compatibility.note: Sections follow the reported native order, a convention rather than verified compatibility. Parsing a projection or a definition does not establish compatibility, and a reader that ignores quotation marks can misread any file that holds author text. Native confirmation of this projection is pending.
